en: Black‑and‑white view of an industrial complex in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground is a landscaped garden with paths, lawns, and small trees surrounding a reflective pond. Behind it stands a large villa-style main building with steep roofs and dormer windows, surrounded by several attached and detached factory buildings and long greenhouse structures. In the middle distance, tall brick and concrete chimneys emit smoke, with additional factory halls and rail tracks visible further up the valley. Forested hills and terraced slopes rise in the background. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
